A Guy With A Scarf research/Automated match video/Premium edition/Pixellot

Platform pays for cameras and shares revenue

PixellotPremium

Israel, with US offices in Atlanta and Durham · founded 2013 · active · www.pixellot.tv · last verified 2026-09-19

Platform pays for cameras and shares revenueFixed multi-lensDeployed in ItalyEvidence B€500 to €2,000 to start

Pixellot builds fixed multi-sensor cameras (Show S3) and a portable one (Air NXT) that produce and stream matches unattended, and sells the output through platform partners such as PlayOn in US high schools and through a direct Pixellot You shop for clubs pix-04, pix-02, pix-06.

For Federations, leagues, school networks and streaming platforms that want hundreds of venues producing live games with graphics and ads and a revenue share on the audience, plus clubs that buy an Air NXT and a Team or Club plan for their own coaching video pix-01, pix-05. Football clubs in Italy get the Air NXT at 999 euros with plans from 1,009 euros per year, and professional academies such as Fiorentina have used the fixed system across a whole training centre pix-05, pix-10.

Pixellot exists because live production of youth sport only pays when a camera costs less than one camera operator per season, and its fixed systems in 9,000 US schools proved that model at scale pix-01. It matters now because the November 2025 PlayOn extension and the January 2026 35 million dollar raise moved the company from selling cameras to sharing revenue on the content the cameras generate, which it calls AI as a Service pix-02, pix-01. That tells you where the space is going, with capture becoming a cost line inside a media business and the vendor's income tied to viewership and monetisation, with hardware reduced to an enabler pix-21.

Price band Pixellot You direct shop: Air NXT €999 plus €1,009 (Team) or €1,299 (Club) per year in the EU price list; fixed Show systems and partner deployments are quote-only or revenue-share pix-05

Italy Fiorentina chose Pixellot for nine pitches at its new training centre in June 2022 and the Lega Nazionale Dilettanti streamed all 114 group matches of the 2023 Torneo delle Regioni with Pixellot technology, while the Pixellot You shop routes Italian demo requests to a local reseller calendar and offers an Italian-language storefront pix-10, pix-11, pix-05.

The verdict

Look if You are a league, federation, school network or streaming platform that wants unattended live production with graphics, ads and commentary across many venues and is prepared to negotiate a revenue share or per-venue contract pix-01, pix-09. You are a club that wants one portable camera for coaching video on a published EU price list and values 12 months of storage and unlimited events on the Club plan pix-05, pix-06.

Skip if You want published fixed-system pricing, a European data residency statement or a downloadable master file from the consumer app, because Pixellot publishes none of these and app reviewers report that the app shares links and offers no file export pix-15, pix-17. You want a vendor with a large public base of coach reviews, since the Pixellot You app has 16 ratings on iOS and 58 on Google Play pix-17, pix-18.

Watch-outs

  • The Pixellot You terms grant Pixellot a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, sublicensable licence to use, distribute and modify your content, and state that Pixellot has no obligation to store it pix-16.
  • Pixellot processes tracking and video data as processor and requires the customer to obtain parental consent for athletes under 18, so the club carries the consent duty and Pixellot offers an opt-out from facial recognition and no blurring pix-15.
  • The privacy policy names Israel as the processing country and relies on standard contractual clauses for EEA transfers, with no named cloud region for European footage pix-15.
  • Pixellot You prices are loaded from a script file whose version stamp dates from March 2025, and the EU plans page itself returned a 404 during verification, so treat the EUR figures as list prices to be confirmed at checkout pix-05, pix-06.
  • Live streaming on the Air NXT is described on the US plans page as coming soon and available in a limited partner release, so a club buying the portable camera for live output should get that in writing pix-06.
  • Fixed Show systems and partner deployments have no public price, and the AIaaS model ties the vendor's revenue to viewership, which shapes what gets built for coaches versus fans pix-21, pix-02.

Products

  • Pixellot Show S3 (camera). Fixed panoramic multi-camera system for 19 sports with automated production, graphics, ads, commentary inputs and live streaming over 3G or 4G, the core of the US high school deployment pix-04, pix-09.
  • Pixellot Air NXT (camera). Portable dual 4K camera under two kilograms with six-hour battery, up to 512 GB storage, Wi-Fi and 4G/5G upload, broadcast, panorama and tactical views pix-07, pix-08.
  • Pixellot DoublePlay (camera). Automated multi-camera production system for baseball and softball pix-04.
  • Pixellot You (platform). Direct-to-club shop and app with Team and Club plans, 12 months storage, unlimited events, VidSwap tools and email and chat support pix-06.
  • Pixellot OTT (platform). White-label streaming platform for engagement and monetisation used by partners pix-04.
  • VidSwap Data and Analytics (add-on). Game breakdown and analytics platform acquired in 2019, sold per game or bundled pix-14, pix-06.
  • Automatic Highlights (add-on). Automated highlight generation across the platform pix-04.

Profile against the 24 criteria

Use-case fit
Pixellot covers 19 sports with sport-specific algorithms and sells two distinct things, a fixed Show S3 system for venues that need live production with graphics, ads and commentary, and a portable Air NXT with a Team or Club plan for coaching video pix-04, pix-09, pix-06. The company's volume sits in US high schools, with 16,000 systems in 9,000 schools streaming more than 500,000 events per year through PlayOn pix-01, pix-02. Football deployments range from the Fiorentina training centre to LND tournament streaming in Italy pix-10, pix-11.
Capture quality
The Air NXT carries a dual 4K 12 megapixel array, a six-hour battery with USB-C charging, up to 512 gigabytes of storage for around 32 hours of video, stereo audio and a weight under two kilograms pix-07, pix-08. It outputs a broadcast view, a full panorama and a tactical view for coaches pix-07. The fixed Show system is a panoramic multi-camera unit that adjusts to poor lighting and adds embedded graphics and audio inputs for commentary pix-09.
Automation accuracy
Pixellot publishes no tracking accuracy figures and describes the production as fully automated with sport-specific AI calibration across 19 sports pix-09. The company added automated first down markers and replays for American football during the PlayOn partnership, which shows the production automation going beyond a follow-cam pix-02. Reviewer commentary on tracking quality is thin, with the Pixellot You app praised for video quality and criticised for playback freezes, with tracking errors absent from the complaints pix-17, pix-18.
Multi-angle and stitching
The Show system stitches a panoramic view from multiple sensors and DoublePlay adds automated multi-camera production for baseball and softball pix-04, pix-09. The Air NXT stitches its two 4K sensors into one panorama and offers no second unit synchronisation in the public material pix-07, pix-08. Third-party camera ingestion is not described for either product pix-09.
Latency and live readiness
Live production is the core of the fixed system, which streams live and on demand with rewind, embedded graphics and ad formats over 3G or 4G connections pix-09. Live streaming on the Air was announced in September 2022 over cellular modem, Ethernet or Wi-Fi, yet the current US plans page still lists live streaming on the Air as coming soon and limited to a partner release pix-22, pix-06. No latency figures are published pix-09.
Reliability and resilience
Pixellot reports 2.5 million production hours in 2025 and an average above 100,000 events per month, which is the strongest volume evidence in this database for unattended production pix-01. The Pixellot You Android app is criticised for freezing during playback and the iOS app for missing iPad support, while the fixed system carries no public reliability data beyond the partner numbers pix-18, pix-17. The B&H listing gives the Air NXT a one-year limited warranty pix-07.
Portability and install
The Air NXT ships in a waterproof case, weighs under two kilograms and runs six hours on battery or longer from a power bank pix-07, pix-08. The Show S3 is a fixed installation for gyms and stadiums and Pixellot publishes no installation guide or cost for it, with partner programmes handling deployment in schools pix-09, pix-02. A GoPro-based entry option exists in the US shop for indoor sports pix-06.
Connectivity and bandwidth
The Air NXT uploads over Wi-Fi or 4G and 5G, and mobile uploads run through the Pixellot Control app pix-07, pix-06. The Show system is described as working on low bandwidth 3G or 4G links for live output pix-09. Pixellot publishes no minimum upload speed for either product pix-08.
Workflow and UX
The Pixellot You app gives clip creation, sharing links and a video player, and the plan includes VidSwap coaching analysis tools and one free automated game breakdown pix-06. App reviewers score it 3.9 on iOS from 16 ratings and 4.0 on Google Play from 58, praising quality and editing and complaining about mandatory fade transitions, no casting to TVs and export that shares links with no file download pix-17, pix-18. The storefront and app are available in Italian, German, Spanish and French pix-06.
Analysis layer
Analysis runs through VidSwap, acquired in 2019, which offers game breakdowns priced at 55 dollars each in the US bundles, with six free on a one-year plan and twelve on a two-year plan pix-14, pix-06. Pixellot Analytics Pro access valued at 500 dollars is bundled with the Air plans pix-06. Tactical full-pitch view and tagging inside the Pixellot application are included on the Air pix-08.
Integrations
Pixellot states it delivers functionality through APIs and SDKs and integrated Helios wearables for automated hockey shift video in April 2026 pix-20. GameChanger integrated Pixellot fixed cameras with QR activation in December 2025, and the Air page says footage can be uploaded to external platforms and third-party breakdown tools pix-19, pix-08. No public API documentation was found during verification pix-20.
Distribution and OTT
Pixellot OTT is a white-label streaming platform for engagement and monetisation, and the company claims 100 million views of live events streamed pix-04, pix-01. Distribution in the US runs through PlayOn's NFHS Network on a five-year revenue-share extension signed in November 2025 pix-02. In Italy the 2023 Torneo delle Regioni was streamed with Pixellot technology in collaboration with the regional broadcaster Ideawebtv pix-11.
Data access and ownership
The Pixellot You terms state that Pixellot claims no ownership of user content while taking a perpetual, irrevocable, sublicensable licence to use, distribute and modify it, and that Pixellot has no obligation to store content and may delete it on termination pix-16. Plans include 12 months of storage pix-06. App reviewers report that the consumer app only shares links and does not export files, and Pixellot publishes no download policy for the panorama master pix-17.
Privacy and compliance
Pixellot acts as processor for tracking and video coverage data on behalf of the customer, requires parental consent for athletes under 18, names a data protection officer and relies on standard contractual clauses for EEA transfers, with Israel as the processing country and no named hosting region pix-15. Customers can opt out of the facial recognition feature, and no blurring or on-pitch opt-out mechanism is described pix-15. The policy was last updated on 19 March 2024 pix-15.
Security
Pixellot states that it implements physical, technical and administrative measures in line with industry standards and names no certification such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001 in its policy pix-15. No security page, status page or penetration test statement was found during verification pix-15. Not assessable beyond this from public sources.
Pricing and TCO
In the EU list a club pays 999 euros for the Air NXT and 1,009 euros per year for the Team plan or 1,299 euros for the Club plan with unlimited teams, so first-year cost is about 2,008 to 2,298 euros before VAT pix-05. Monthly billing runs 109 euros for Team and 139 for Club, and the US shop offers two-year terms at 1,899 and 2,477 dollars with a free Air camera on yearly subscriptions promoted on the page pix-05, pix-06. Fixed Show systems and federation deployments are quote-only, and press coverage of the AIaaS model indicates no upfront camera cost for partners in exchange for a revenue share pix-01, pix-21.
Support and service
Pixellot You plans include free email and chat support, with a Zoho desk widget on the storefront and regional demo calendars by US region and by country pix-06, pix-05. No response time targets, SLAs or warranty terms beyond the one-year limited warranty in the B&H listing are published pix-07. App reviewers describe support as responsive in getting cameras shipped pix-17.
Company health and roadmap
Pixellot raised 161 million dollars in 2022 at a 500 million dollar valuation led by PSG Equity, then 35 million dollars in January 2026 as 15 million equity from PSG and 20 million venture debt pix-12, pix-01. Doron Gerstel, former Perion CEO, replaced founder-era CEO Alon Werber in November 2024 when the company had around 200 employees, and the strategy since then centres on AIaaS revenue sharing, personalisation and monetisation pix-13, pix-21. The press release feed shows no product or partnership announcement between April and September 2026 pix-03.
Evidence and references
Fiorentina selected Pixellot in June 2022 for nine pitches with live streaming, analytics and highlights across the academy, women's and men's teams pix-10. The Lega Nazionale Dilettanti used Pixellot as technology partner to stream all 114 group matches of the 59th Torneo delle Regioni in April 2023 pix-11. The homepage lists Real Sociedad, Benfica, the Scottish Premiership and Grupo Globo among partners, and PlayOn reports 3.4 million high school events produced with Pixellot pix-04, pix-02. Italian trade press in August 2026 lists the Air NXT among the reference football cameras and notes that it requires a custom quote pix-23.
Coach and analyst satisfaction
Public coach feedback is limited to 16 iOS ratings at 3.9 and 58 Google Play reviews at 4.0 for the Pixellot You app pix-17, pix-18. Positive comments cite video quality and editing, negative ones cite playback freezes, no iPad version, no casting and export limited to links pix-17, pix-18. Not assessable at statistical scale from public sources.
Edge versus cloud
The Air NXT records locally to up to 512 gigabytes and uploads afterwards, while the fixed Show system produces live in an automated workflow that Pixellot describes as delivering footage without human intervention pix-07, pix-09. Pixellot describes the Helios integration as processing in the cloud the moment the game hits it pix-20. The split of AI work between the camera and the cloud is not documented publicly pix-09.
Accessibility and languages
The Pixellot You storefront and demo flow run in English, German, Spanish, Mexican Spanish, French and Italian, with country-specific demo calendars for Italy, Germany, France, the UK, Australia, Mexico and Canada pix-06, pix-05. Pixellot has offices in Israel, Atlanta and Durham and appointed a chief commercial officer for Australia and New Zealand in December 2025 pix-14, pix-24.
Upgrade path
A club can start with the Air NXT on a Team plan, move to the Club plan with unlimited teams and sports, and add VidSwap breakdowns per game pix-06. Venues that need live production with graphics move to the fixed Show S3 and Pixellot OTT, which are sold through partners or direct quotes pix-09, pix-04. DoublePlay covers baseball and softball with multi-camera production for organisations that expand beyond football pix-04.
Differentiators worth testing
Test the Show S3 live output with graphics and commentary on a real match against your bandwidth, because low-bandwidth live production is the claim that separates Pixellot from portable rivals pix-09. Test the Air NXT tactical view and panorama export for your analysts, since the consumer app is criticised for link-only sharing pix-08, pix-17. Ask for the AIaaS terms in writing, including who owns the audience data and the ad inventory pix-21, pix-02.

Company

Ownership and funding Pixellot is a private Israeli company founded in 2013 by Gal Oz and Miky Tamir that raised 3 million dollars in 2014 led by Baidu, 30 million in 2018, 16 million in 2020 and 161 million in 2022 at a 500 million dollar valuation led by PSG Equity with Firstime, Shamrock Capital, Altshuler Shaham and Meitav Dash, part of it secondary pix-14, pix-12. In January 2026 PSG Equity added 15 million dollars of equity alongside 20 million dollars of venture debt pix-01.

Financials Not public. The company discloses production volume and deployment counts and no revenue or profit figures pix-01.

Scale, company-stated January 2026: 2.5 million production hours in 2025, more than 100,000 events per month, around 100 million live views, 16,000 systems in 9,000 US schools and more than 500,000 US school events per year pix-01. December 2025: more than 30,000 systems sold worldwide pix-19. Homepage counters show 38,480 systems in 80 countries and more than five million games broadcast pix-04. November 2024: around 200 employees and more than 150,000 events produced per month pix-13.

Partnerships

  • PlayOn Sports and the NFHS Network, five-year extension signed 5 November 2025 on an AIaaS revenue-share model, with 3.4 million events produced since 2017 pix-02.
  • GameChanger, a DICK'S Sporting Goods company, fixed cameras at recreational baseball and softball fields after a 32-league pilot, announced 19 December 2025 pix-19.
  • Helios wearables, automated hockey shift video integration announced 23 April 2026 pix-20.
  • ACF Fiorentina, nine-pitch training centre deployment announced 28 June 2022 pix-10.
  • Lega Nazionale Dilettanti, technology partner for the 2023 Torneo delle Regioni streaming with Ideawebtv pix-11.

  • Whether the EUR prices in the site script are the prices charged at checkout today, since the script is stamped March 2025 and the EU plans page returned a 404 pix-05, pix-06.
  • The identity and status of Pixellot's Italian reseller; the storefront routes Italian demos to a calendar under the name sportanalisi, whose own website does not mention Pixellot pix-05.
  • Whether the Fiorentina installation is still in service in 2026 pix-10.
  • The cloud provider and region used for European footage pix-15.
  • Tracking accuracy, latency and uptime figures for either camera line pix-09.
  • Whether live streaming is generally available on the Air NXT outside partner programmes pix-06, pix-22.
  • Revenue, profitability and current headcount pix-01.
